facts.fact: A group of private investors led by Tell Group, a financial services company, with Groupe Industriel Babahoum Algerie (GIBA, Algerian conglomerate) taking part, put 600 million dinars (about USD 5 million) into the Algerian travel-tech start-up VOLZ in a funding round announced in December 2025, per TechCabal.

The VOLZ round of 600 million dinars (about USD 5 million) was raised in dinars from Algerian investors led by Tell Group and including GIBA, which TechCabal calls the largest Algerian start-up round in dinars and a win for local capital formation.
